about: The brawler's songs and sound effects: tools/port/build_snd.py builds the M ROM (KOF98's driver + these songs) and the V ROM (only their samples) and build/snd/songs.h (MUS_<name> = the driver command). source = the game whose driver the song comes from (kof98 = KOF98's own song, kept as is; others are ported into KOF98's format by tools/port/port98.py); cmd = the song's command in that game (docs/<game>_songs.md).
